visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens with a wide shot of a massive indoor stadium at night. A female performer with dark hair in a ponytail, wearing a white sleeveless top and a khaki mini-skirt, dances on a brightly lit stage. She moves her arms rhythmically as pink and purple light sticks from the audience glow in the background. (2) The camera transitions to a medium shot focusing on another female performer with long brown hair, dressed in a white tank top with thin straps and a similar khaki skirt. She smiles while executing precise dance moves and holding a microphone. The background is filled with blurred figures of the audience and a large screen displaying concert visuals. (3) A third performer is seen from behind, walking across the stage. She wears a white t-shirt with black text on the back and khaki shorts. The lighting shifts to a cooler blue and purple tone as she moves towards a group of backup dancers. (4) The focus returns to the first performer in a medium close-up. She performs a series of expressive hand gestures and facial expressions, including winking and smiling at the camera. The camera zooms in and out dynamically, tracking her energetic movements across the stage under intense spotlighting.
